```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
options(scipen=999)
library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)
library(lubridate)
library(rvest)
```

```{r}
library(rvest)

# Read the HTML
crime_data <- read_html("https://umpd.umd.edu/statistics-reports/daily-crime-and-incident-logs/2025/10")

tables <- crime_data %>% html_table()

df <- tables[[1]]
```


```{r}
colnames(df)[colnames(df) == ""] <- paste0("col_", seq_along(colnames(df)[colnames(df) == ""]))

# Add row numbers to track pairs
df <- df %>%
  mutate(row_num = row_number())

# Separate into crime data rows (odd rows) and address rows (even rows)
crime_rows <- df %>%
  filter(row_num %% 2 == 1)

address_rows <- df %>%
  filter(row_num %% 2 == 0) %>%
  # Extract address from the second column (Date Occurred column in address rows)
  select(address = 2)

# Combine crime data with addresses
crime_df_clean <- crime_rows %>%
  select(-row_num) %>%
  bind_cols(address_rows) %>%
  # Clean up the address column
  mutate(address = trimws(address))

# View the cleaned data
head(crime_df_clean, 20)

# Optional: Save to CSV
write.csv(crime_df_clean, "crime_data_clean.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# Summary of the data
cat("Total incidents:", nrow(crime_df_clean), "\n")
cat("\nFirst few entries with addresses:\n")
crime_df_clean %>%
  select(`UMPD Case Number`, `Date Occurred`, `Crime Type`, Disposition, address) %>%
  head(10) %>%
  print()

# Crime type summary
cat("\nCrime types:\n")
table(crime_df_clean$`Crime Type`)
```

```{r}
library(rvest)
library(dplyr)

# Read the data
crime_data <- read_html("https://umpd.umd.edu/statistics-reports/daily-crime-and-incident-logs/2025/10")
tables <- crime_data %>% html_table()
df <- tables[[1]]

# Show the first several rows
print(head(df, 20))

# Show column names
print(colnames(df))

# Show structure
print(str(df))
```

```{r}
crime_df_clean %>% 
  group_by(`Crime Type`) %>% 
  summarise(crime = n()) %>% 
  arrange(desc(crime))
```
